name: Audio routing
description: A fourth dashboard tab under the vitals: every program playing audio, which output it goes to, a volume slider and mute for each, and a dropdown to move it elsewhere, including into EasyEffects. Same again for microphones. Master rows set the default device; per-device rows appear when programs are split across outputs. Follows the Ambxst theme live. Also adds the 'audio' / 'dashboard-audio' IPC commands.
author: drpezzer
permissions: Reads and moves PipeWire streams with pactl (pipewire-pulse)
Changes stream, device and default-device volumes
Can rewrite EasyEffects' output device in ~/.config/easyeffects/db/easyeffectsrc and restart EasyEffects when asked to from the tab
Launches easyeffects and pavucontrol from the titlebar buttons
